paper_title: How to Generate Popular Post Headlines on Social Media
caption: The average similarities between the headlines from different seasons
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the average similarities between headlines from different seasons across varying time intervals. The x-axis is labeled "Δ Days" and represents categorical time intervals, with slanted tick labels sequentially listed as "(0,90]", "(90,180]", "(180,270]", "(270,360]", and "(360,450]". The y-axis, labeled "Avg. similarity (10e-2)", features a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 0.05, displaying values of 1.70, 1.75, 1.80, and 1.85. A single light blue dash-dot line with solid circular markers, enclosed within a faint light blue shaded band, represents the data. The line begins at its highest point of approximately 1.84 at the "(0,90]" interval. It subsequently declines to 1.80 at "(90,180]" and continues to drop to approximately 1.72 at "(180,270]". The line then shows a slight increase, reaching approximately 1.74 at "(270,360]", before decreasing to end at its lowest value of approximately 1.68 at the final "(360,450]" interval.
